channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Türkiye neutralizes threats at source beyond its borders: Erdoğan
item.description: Türkiye takes all necessary steps beyond its borders for its security, neutralizing threats at their source without seeking permission from anyone, Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan said on Thursday.

item.title: Turkish, Bulgarian scientists uncover Antarctica’s geological history
item.description: Turkish and Bulgarian geologists participating in Türkiye’s 10th Antarctic Science Expedition have launched a joint research initiative to uncover Antarctica’s geological history and assess its implications for future climate change.

item.title: Financial incentives for Turkish TV series energize exporters
item.description: Culture and Tourism Minister Mehmet Nuri Ersoy’s recent announcement of financial incentives for Turkish dramas broadcast abroad has energized the country’s exporters.

item.title: Şimşek: Inflation could fall below past averages in spring
item.description: Finance Minister Mehmet Şimşek said Türkiye may see inflation drop below past averages in March, April and May.

item.title: Gürlek: Parliament to decide on legal reforms under anti-terror bid
item.description: Newly appointed Justice Minister Akın Gürlek has said decisions on legal regulations expected within the government’s anti-terror initiative will be made by parliament.

item.title: Türkiye and Saudi Arabia sign landmark solar power deal
item.description: Energy and Natural Resources Minister Alparslan Bayraktar announced that Türkiye and Saudi Arabia have signed a renewable energy agreement under which Saudi energy company ACWA Power will build solar power plants in Sivas and Karaman Taşeli.

item.title: Türkiye ready to contribute to Gaza 'in every way possible': FM Fidan
item.description: Türkiye is ready to contribute to Gaza "in every way possible," Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan said Thursday.

item.title: Erdoğan says renewables reach 62 pct of installed capacity
item.description: Türkiye has increased the share of renewables in its total installed electricity capacity to 62 percent by expanding wind and solar power, President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan said on Friday.

item.title: Trump says weighing strike on Iran as Tehran says draft deal coming soon
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump said he was considering a limited strike on Iran after ordering a major naval buildup in the Middle East aimed at heaping pressure on Tehran to cut a deal to curb its nuclear programme.

item.title: US Supreme Court strikes down swath of Trump global tariffs
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court ruled Friday that Donald Trump exceeded his authority in imposing a swath of tariffs that upended global trade, blocking a key tool the president has wielded to impose his economic agenda.
